crossRefs.note: So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria…
In the days of Pekah king of Israel, Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria came and took Ijon, Abel Beth Maacah, Janoah…
So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria, saying, “I am your servant and your son. Come up and save…

people.name: Assyria
people.line: A powerful ancient empire, often in conflict with Israel.

people.name: Beerah
people.line: A Reubenite leader exiled by the Assyrian king Tiglath-Pileser.

people.name: Reuben
people.line: Firstborn son of Jacob and Leah

people.name: Tiglath-pileser
people.line: Assyrian king who conquered parts of Israel

translations.web: and Beerah his son, whom Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria carried away captive. He was prince of the Reubenites.
translations.bsb: and Beerah his son, whom Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria carried into exile. Beerah was a leader of the Reubenites.
translations.kjv: Beerah his son, whom Tilgathpilneser king of Assyria carried away captive: he was prince of the Reubenites.
translations.asv: Beerah his son, whom Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria carried away captive: he was prince of the Reubenites.
